title: Children shifting random number generators with thought
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: technological a random number generator, there are examples where I personally and watched other kids push them sigas sigas of multitudes and held for hours just by using our thoughts.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO-related program as a child, claims that he and other children could push random number generators, machines that spit out chance results, far away from chance just by thinking. He tells Michels this happened around 2008 to 2010 at a place in Western New York called Baker Victory Services, and that the kids pushed the machines by many "sigmas", a statistical measure of how unlikely a result is, and held them there for hours. If true, it would mean the mind can directly affect physical machines.
